signature: SUBROUTINE ZGETC2( N, A, LDA, IPIV, JPIV, INFO )

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the n-by-n matrix to be factored. On exit, the factors L and U from the factorization $A = P \, L \, U \, Q$; the unit diagonal elements of L are not stored. If U(k, k) appears to be less than SMIN, U(k, k) is given the value of SMIN, giving a nonsingular perturbed system.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1, N)$.

params.name: IPIV
params.reference: The pivot indices; for $1 \le i \le N$, row i of the matrix has been interchanged with row `IPIV(i)`.

params.name: JPIV
params.reference: The pivot indices; for $1 \le j \le N$, column j of the matrix has been interchanged with column `JPIV(j)`.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `> 0`: if `INFO = k`, U(k, k) is likely to produce overflow if one tries to solve for x in $\mathrm{Ax} = b$. So U is perturbed to avoid the overflow.
